nodes.description: Contract version counter, updated on initialize and on each UUPS upgrade authorization.
Last minted token id counter, incremented in _safeMint and read by totalSupply.
Number of burned tokens, incremented in burn and subtracted in totalSupply.
Number of created planets, used to bound setupPlanet and setupMintRound ids.
Number of created mint rounds, used to bound round id creation.
Mapping of planetId to Planet struct (supply, minted, reveal state, distributor, burnable).
Mapping of roundId to MintRound struct (prices, supplies, validator, per-user minted counters).
Mapping tokenId to land type, written in _safeMint and read in tokenURI.
Mapping tokenId to planetId, written in _safeMint and read in burn/tokenURI.
Initializer for upgradeable contract; sets name/symbol and version = 1.
External payable mint without whitelist, restricted to rounds with validator == address(0).
External payable mint requiring an ECDSA signature from the round validator plus maxMint enforcement.
Mints tokens to an arbitrary wallet; callable only by contract owner or the planet distributor.
Owner-only creation/edition of a planet: types number, per-type supply and unrevealed URIs.
Owner-only one-time reveal of a planet, setting baseURI and baseExtension.
Owner-only change of a planet baseURI and baseExtension.
Owner-only toggle of the burnable flag of a planet.
Owner-only assignment of the airdrop distributor of a planet.
Owner-only creation/edition of a mint round: timings, validator, prices, supplies and per-type max mints.
Owner-only pause of mints, transfers and burns.
Owner-only unpause of the contract.
Burns a token if its planet is burnable; increments burnedCounter and calls ERC721 burn.
Owner-only withdrawal of native coin using a low-level call forwarding all gas.
Owner-only withdrawal of ERC20 tokens via SafeERC20 safeTransfer.
Returns the revealed or unrevealed URI of a token depending on planet state.
Returns _tokenIdCounter - burnedCounter.
Internal round mint: checks round window via block.timestamp, price/msg.value, round supply and per-user max, then mints and updates counters.
Internal mint loop that validates land type, amount and planet supply, writes token metadata and calls ERC721 _safeMint (external callback).
Verifies payload expiration against block.timestamp and recovers the ECDSA signer of the mint payload.
Pausable hook executed before every mint, burn and transfer.
UUPS upgrade authorization, restricted to onlyOwner, increments version.
Fallback receive function accepting native coin.
Untrusted caller address used for authorization and per-user mint accounting.
Untrusted block timestamp used for round windows and signature expiration.
to.call{value: amount}("") in withdraw forwards all gas to an owner-chosen address before state finalization.
ECDSA recover of the mint signature; result compared to the configured round validator.
ERC721 _safeMint triggers onERC721Received on contract recipients, an external callback during minting.
SafeERC20 safeTransfer performs an external call to an arbitrary token address supplied by the owner.
Arithmetic evaluation round.pricePerType[landType] * amount compared to msg.value.
Round activation check depending on block.timestamp, startTime and duration.

edges.reason: mint uses msg.sender as the mint recipient and payer identity.
mintWithValidation binds msg.sender into the signed payload and the max mint check.
airdrop authorizes msg.sender as owner or planet distributor.
burn authorization relies on msg.sender being owner or approved operator.
_roundMint reads msg.sender for per-user minted accounting.
Round activation depends on block.timestamp compared to startTime and duration.
Signature expiration compares payloadExpiration with block.timestamp.
mint delegates the minting work to _roundMint.
mintWithValidation gates minting on _checkSignature validation.
mintWithValidation calls _roundMint after validation.
mintWithValidation emits no external token call but reuses the mint pipeline.
airdrop calls the internal _safeMint.
_roundMint calls _safeMint and only afterwards updates round counters.
ERC721 _safeMint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook during minting.
burn reaches _beforeTokenTransfer through the inherited burn/_burn path.
_safeMint causes an external onERC721Received callback on contract recipients while counters are still pending.
price times amount multiplication is the payment check in _roundMint.
_roundMint enforces the round window using block.timestamp.
withdraw performs a full-gas low-level value call to a caller-chosen address.
withdrawTokens calls safeTransfer on an arbitrary token address, an external call.
_checkSignature recovers the signer with ecrecover and compares to the validator.
mint roundId selects the round used for minting.
mint landType is forwarded to _roundMint.
mint amount is forwarded to _roundMint.
mintWithValidation roundId is part of the verified payload.
mintWithValidation landType is part of the verified payload.
mintWithValidation amount is added to the user total before the max check.
maxMint bounds how many tokens the caller may mint.
payloadExpiration limits signature validity.
sig is the authorization proof consumed by _checkSignature.
airdrop wallet receives the minted tokens.
airdrop planetId selects the planet and distributor check.
airdrop landType is minted.
airdrop amount is minted.
setupPlanet planetId targets the planet storage entry.
setupPlanet typesNumber sizes the supply and URI arrays.
setupPlanet supplyPerType writes planets.supplyPerType.
setupPlanet notRevealUriPerType writes unrevealed URIs.
setupMintRound roundId selects or creates the round.
setupMintRound planetId links the round to a planet.
setupMintRound startTime defines the round opening.
setupMintRound duration defines the round length.
setupMintRound validator becomes the trusted signer for the round.
setupMintRound limitedPerType changes the per-user accounting mode.
setupMintRound pricePerType writes round prices.
setupMintRound supplyPerType writes round supplies.
setupMintRound maxMintPerType writes per-user limits.
withdraw to address is the external call target.
withdraw amount is the value sent in the low-level call.
withdrawTokens to is the transfer recipient.
withdrawTokens token is the arbitrary external contract called.
withdrawTokens amount is transferred.
_roundMint wallet receives the minted tokens.
_roundMint roundId indexes the round storage.
_roundMint landType selects price, supply and max entries.
_roundMint amount is minted and added to counters.
_safeMint wallet is the token recipient.
_safeMint planetId selects the planet supply entry.
_safeMint landType is validated against planet.typesNumber.
_safeMint amount drives the mint loop and supply check.
signed payload includes the wallet to prevent signature reuse.
payloadExpiration is checked against block.timestamp.
maxMint is authenticated inside the signed payload.
landType is authenticated inside the signed payload.
roundId is authenticated inside the signed payload.
sig is the signature recovered and compared with the validator.
signer is the expected validator address for the comparison.
burn tokenId determines the planet and ownership checks.
local totalRoundMinted drives the round max allowance check.
local tokenId is derived from and written back to _tokenIdCounter.
local planetId gates the burnable requirement.
local totalRoundMinted is compared with maxMint before minting.
Configured pricePerType feeds the price times amount arithmetic.
Mint amount is an operand of the price multiplication.
setupPlanet writes planet types, supplies and unrevealed URIs.
revealPlanet writes revealed flag and base URI data.
setPlanetBaseURI writes planet base URI data.
setPlanetBurnable writes the planet burnable flag.
setPlanetDistributor writes the planet distributor address.
setupMintRound writes the round configuration.
setupMintRound reads planets typesNumber for array length validation.
_roundMint reads and updates round prices, supplies and minted counters.
_safeMint reads and updates planet supply and total minted.
_safeMint writes tokenType for each new token.
_safeMint writes tokenPlanet for each new token.
_safeMint increments and persists _tokenIdCounter.
burn increments burnedCounter.
burn reads tokenPlanet to resolve the planet.
burn reads the planet burnable flag.
totalSupply reads _tokenIdCounter.
totalSupply subtracts burnedCounter.
tokenURI reads tokenPlanet to find the planet.
tokenURI reads tokenType for the unrevealed URI.
tokenURI reads planet reveal state and base URI data.
initialize sets version = 1.
_authorizeUpgrade increments version on upgrade.
pause toggles the paused flag checked by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
unpause toggles the paused flag checked by the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
